description: BMS Telemetry Export Manifest — expected raw data row counts per source file. A 'raw data row' is every non-blank, non-header line. Use verify_export.py to assert parser output matches these totals.

_notes.null_count: null means the file is listed for existence-checking only — any non-zero parse is a PASS.
_notes.real_files: When the actual 12x component_*.csv and 12x device_*.csv exports are placed in /data, add each filename and its expected row count (total non-blank, non-header lines across all blocks in the file) to this dict.
